messages:
Alex Kim: heads up — my flight just rebooked, likely OOO for the 20:00–06:00 UTC window. I still have the pager but won't be able to respond fast. Can someone swap primary with me for tonight?

Priya Rao: @Alex Kim — thanks for the ping. Are you currently primary or shadow?

Alex Kim: primary tonight. Secondary is @Michael Chen (shadow).

incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: PagerDuty trigger #PD-4289 for service `redwood-inference-api` at 2024-11-12T17:42:10Z. Severity: P1 (potential customer impact).

Michael Chen: ack, I can take primary for tonight if Priya can cover shadow. I'm at my desk for the next 90m to take handoff.

Priya Rao: I can move to shadow. Quick question — any active incidents right now or is that PD noise?

Alex Kim: small blip earlier, autoscaler flapped for a burst of requests, we recovered but logs spiked. I put the runbook in the thread: https://confluence.internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/primary-swap-checklist

Julia Herrera: pinging ops channel for metrics snapshot, will paste the dashboard link.

Julia Herrera: metrics: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/7f2a/inference-slo?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now — latency spike at 17:39 UTC, error rate up to 0.9% for 2m then back to 0.05%. No active customer escalations.

Priya Rao: ok sounds low risk. Alex — can you confirm you want an immediate swap? I can do manual swap now and tag you shadow if you confirm.

Alex Kim: yes please swap now. I'm boarding in 12m and won't be able to respond reliably. Thanks.

Michael Chen: I'll take over primary responsibilities. Will check the canary routes and keep an eye on autoscaler configs.

Priya Rao: doing swap command now — `/oncall swap --from "Alex Kim" --to "Michael Chen" --role primary --until 2024-11-13T06:00:00Z`

incident-bot: ONCALL CHANGE: Alex Kim -> Michael Chen (primary) [effective now]. Shadow: Priya Rao. Duration: until 2024-11-13T06:00:00Z. Change recorded in Ops Audit ID: OA-7782.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded for PD-4289 by Michael Chen.

Michael Chen: confirmed, I see the PD ack. Quick checklist: 1) watch canary, 2) keep latency SLO tab on, 3) escalate to oncall-sre if errors >1% sustained 5m.

Priya Rao: I'll take the canary routing checks and runbook actions if it reoccurs. Runbook excerpt I used:```
- verify autoscaler group sizes
- check GPU pool health: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l role=gpu`
- if OOMs or kernel panics, fallback to smaller model pool
- notify customer-impact Slack (#customer-impact) if errors >1% for 10m
```

Alex Kim: added note: my steps before leaving — closed a deploy window, ensured model cache primed, left a pinned link to recent deploy: https://git.redwood.com/r/inference/deploys/commits/ae3f9

Julia Herrera: tagging runbook pointer to the thread: https://confluence.internal.redwood/runbooks/incidents/autoscaler-flapping-guide — includes playbook and kubectl snippets.

Michael Chen: running quick health checks now: `curl -sS https://health.redwood.internal/api/health | jq .` returns healthy, but node pool `gpu-pool-3` shows 2 pods NotReady for 30s. Investigating.

Priya Rao: if those pods recover within 2m it's probably transient. If they keep cycling, escalate and open a mitigation ticket. I'll standby on shadow.

Michael Chen: pods came back to Ready state. Error trace shows transient OOM on one worker after a burst. I increased `replicas` for inference-worker to 8 from 6 temporarily.

incident-bot: CHANGE NOTE: Scale action recorded by Michael Chen — `kubectl scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=8 -n inference`. Audit ID: CH-5590.

Priya Rao: thanks. Can you push a quick rollback policy if we see more OOMs? Also set a short-term autoscaler min to 6 to avoid downscaling below baseline.

Michael Chen: done: applied HPA minReplicas=6. I also opened a short-lived alerts ticket: https://issues.redwood.com/PROD-1229 — tagging SRE oncall.

Alex Kim: appreciate the smooth handoff — Priya/Michael. I'm leaving my phone on but will be slow. If anything P1, page me with the PD critical policy.

Priya Rao: noted. Shadow coverage confirmed — I'll take over immediate recon if the error rises again.

Michael Chen: I'm primary in the system. Leaving a short note in the incident channel and setting a reminder to hand back to Alex at 2024-11-13T06:05:00Z.

incident-bot: REMINDER scheduled: handback check at 2024-11-13T06:05:00Z.

Priya Rao: final checklist before we close this thread: 1) metrics stable 2) PD incident acknowledged 3) autoscaler min set 4) Alex shadowed and reachable. All good.

Alex Kim: thanks all — very smooth. Safe to close thread on my side.

Michael Chen: closing for now, will reopen if anything pops. :thumbsup:

Julia Herrera: leaving a short postmortem stub in #postmortems if we need more analysis later.

Alex Kim: thanks team :)
